scope: Godot macOS desktop first example battle and a separate cold restart. Synthetic raw keyboard, mouse and controller events enter Godot GUI and InputMap. This is separate from the complete example-night acceptance and physical-device testing.
setup: Two independent processes in temporary source copies, with every user:// gameplay path rewritten to the isolated state directory and native data directory names unique to the verifier.
